content: Community report/auto-hide moderation is typically event-driven: report submission increments a counter (Redis/KV) keyed by content ID; reporter gets immediate soft-mute (content disappears from their view); when counter crosses threshold (industry norm 3-5 reports, 3 is common for small marketplaces) status flips to hidden/needs_review. Never auto-takedown on a single report (abuse/competitor-weapon risk). Decouple report ingestion from any deeper review pipeline so reporting stays available even if review backs up.
